label: Uruk transition horizon around 3500 BC

location.coordinateMeaning: The same broad archaeological-site centre used by URU-3200; it is not a phase-resolved street or building footprint.

temporal.supportedResolution: A transition or early Late-Uruk horizon in an inhabited and urbanising site.
temporal.precisionBoundary: Available sources do not resolve an exact 3500 BC site area, population, writing state, wall, precinct plan, street, or density at the pin.

habitation.evidence: Uruk was inhabited and urbanising in the broad transition toward the city strongly documented by around 3200 BC.
habitation.qualification: The evidence supports habitation and institutional mudbrick material, but not a scored settled-versus-dense state for this exact pin and label.

viewpoint.support: A provisional compacted-earth or mudbrick-compatible exterior at the broad site, pending phase-resolved spatial evidence.

visibleGroundTruth.claim: The requested label belongs to the transition into the Late Uruk urban horizon.
visibleGroundTruth.visualConsequence: A provisional view may use inhabited urbanising mudbrick and institutional work without importing the full 3200 BC city claim.

visibleGroundTruth.claim: By around 3200 BC Uruk was a true city with monumental mudbrick, cone mosaics, and administrative pictographs.
visibleGroundTruth.visualConsequence: These are later comparison obligations, not automatic 3500 BC scenery.

visibleGroundTruth.claim: The exact growth and spatial process around this transition are not resolved well enough for a controlled visual difference at the site-centre pin.
visibleGroundTruth.visualConsequence: The card stops scored rendering until a phase-resolved archaeological source supplies the ground, density, and built state.

obligations: Treat the view as provisional urbanising Uruk rather than a smaller copy of the 3200 BC card.
Keep mudbrick and institutional activity broad unless a phase-resolved source is added.
Withhold exact population, site area, writing, wall, precinct plan, and dense street geometry.
Return source-unavailable for a scored three-stop comparison until the 3500 BC spatial gap is closed.
oracleOnlyContradictions: The 3200 BC city scale and material package cannot be shifted wholesale to 3500 BC.
